verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents a launch system that coordinates multiple long-running nodes, managed-lifecycle nodes, and actions for long-running tasks with feedback, so autonomously running processes are part of its own design. However, the user must write those nodes in code, and nothing shows a first-party way to define, schedule, or trigger background automations. Missing for 10: a documented automation or scheduling feature (triggers, cron-like jobs, background agents), AI-native setup flows, and hands-on corroboration of unattended background operation.
